integrity: Exhaustive checks supplement but do not replace the analytical infinite-size proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The asserted Gibbs stationary measure is an established premise for the dynamically active class. The result requires K and N-K at least two, strictly positive transition rates, and in the crossover strictly interior asymptotic density and q/N² tending to a positive finite constant. Its novelty may have unindexed analogues in canonical Ising scaling results.
title: Bessel cluster crossover and strict finite-size transport deficit in tandem exclusion
